answer: Recency-decayed standing resists sybils: influence decays exponentially each epoch absent fresh graded work, so standing is a lotus that wilts without continuous watering. An attacker cannot pre-age a dormant reserve army and wake it on cue — every stockpiled identity bleeds weight on the ridge of elapsed time and arrives near-zero. Holding N identities at real influence demands N parallel streams of genuine per-epoch contribution forever, a recurring cost no zephyr of one-time setup can cover. Honest active agents stay topped up by the work they already do; idle fleets evaporate.
